words.gloss_range: the definite sun as a nominative subject in a verbless cosmic-state claim
words.root_gloss_range: sun, daylight, radiance, exposure, and related force images; local form selects the concrete solar body under reckoning
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسُ}} ({{tr:ash-shamsu}}) begins with a known celestial body, not a newly introduced object, and it moves the discourse from the prior human pronoun chain into impersonal cosmic subjects. Its nominative form makes the ayah assert a standing condition rather than narrate a making-event, while the delayed predicate will explain the body through reckoned order. The root {{ar:ش م س}} ({{tr:sh-m-s}}) can carry radiance, exposure, and force, but the local noun keeps that intensity as the sun itself and places it under calculation. Its geminated opening sound gives the first body acoustic density, and its place in the recurrent sun-moon pairing makes the opening concrete before the ayah closes on the governing law; parallels such as explicit running in 36:38, orbital language in 36:40, worship-risk in 41:37, lamp imagery in 71:16, and collapse in 75:9 sharpen what 55:5 does by withholding those frames and presenting the sun as one member of a measured pair.

topics.headline: known sun as nominative state-subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the received case makes the sun part of a verbless standing assertion, while the qiraat contrast shows how an accusative would shift toward made-object syntax.
topics.reason: The bundle aligns the word as definite, nominative, and subject of a nominal sentence; variant accusative pressure is useful as contrast but does not override the received parse.

topics.headline: radiant force placed under reckoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the solar image is not raw brightness alone; its radiance and force are made legible as governed, measured creation.
topics.reason: V4 keeps sun/daylight as the selected branch, while restive or hostile branches are not local senses; their force imagery can only remain as narrowed background pressure.

topics.headline: sun-moon pair enters a reckoning field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sun is not explained alone; it launches a recognized sun-moon dyad whose shared predicate makes calculation the point.
topics.reason: The contextual profiles show strong sun-moon pairing and the local syntax coordinates both subjects before the reckoning predicate; references such as 10:5, 6:96, 36:40, 41:37, 71:16, and 75:9 are comparative, not controlling.

topics.headline: dense solar opening before delayed law
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first gives a concrete, acoustically dense solar opening, then waits to disclose the law at the end.
topics.reason: The word opens the ayah, its article is visible in the written form and assimilated in recitation, and the predicate is delayed until after the pair.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the moon to the sun under one predicate
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the small hinge that prevents a one-body reading. Here it is coordination, not oath, restart, or circumstantial wa, because it joins two nominative subjects before the shared predicate. Its payoff is structural and audible: the moon is added as a distinct second body, yet the pair is assembled before calculation is named. The particle therefore makes the ayah read as one binary cosmic system under one reckoning frame.

topics.headline: coordination selected from broad wa functions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle is not swearing, restarting, or merely accompanying; it grammatically adds the moon to the same predicate.
topics.reason: Local nominative parity and the attachment evidence select atf coordination while excluding oath, resumption, and circumstantial functions as local readings.

topics.headline: binary pair assembled before reckoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction preserves two bodies but makes the reckoning predicate fall over them together.
topics.reason: The particle stands between two nominative subjects, completes the subject complex, and extends the delayed predicate to both.

topics.headline: written and recited joining
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the joining is visible at the word edge and audible in the flow into the second noun.
topics.reason: The proclitic form fuses the conjunction to the following noun, and recitation carries through without a hard syntactic restart.

words.gloss_range: the definite moon as a nominative coordinated subject sharing the reckoning predicate
words.root_gloss_range: moon, moonlight, phase visibility, and other moonlit or chance-related branches; local form selects the concrete lunar body under reckoning
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَمَرُ}} ({{tr:al-qamaru}}) completes the subject pair before the reckoning phrase arrives. Its nominative case and definiteness make the moon a known co-subject, not an afterthought or an object in a making-event. The heard article boundary and masculine noun form keep it formally distinct from the sun even as both share one predicate. The root {{ar:ق م ر}} ({{tr:q-m-r}}) brings the moon and its changing light into view; related chance, dazzling, or moon-struck branches are narrowed to background because the local noun is the celestial body whose phases become calculable. The word also gathers a larger lunar-order field: 10:5 and 36:39 make lunar mansions explicit, 12:4 stages the pair as vision-actors, and 55:5 compresses those possibilities into one impersonal measured predicate.

topics.headline: known moon as nominative co-subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moon shares the standing predicate as a co-subject, while the accusative variants show the alternate made-object route that the received form does not take.
topics.reason: The local grammar marks the moon as nominative and coordinated with the first subject; qiraat case pressure is retained only as contrast.

topics.headline: lunar change made calculable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moon's visible variability is not instability here; it becomes phase-marking and measured periodicity.
topics.reason: V4 selects the moon/moonlight branch for the local noun; gambling, dazzling, and other branches may illustrate contrast but cannot govern the local sense.

topics.headline: moon joins recurring measured pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moon is interpreted through a recurrent sun-moon-reckoning field, not as an isolated night object.
topics.reason: The contextual data strongly links the moon with the sun and reckoning roots; references including 10:5, 12:4, 35:13, 36:39, and 6:96 remain comparative witnesses to the local compression.

topics.headline: distinct moon form under shared law
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moon remains formally distinct from the sun in article sound and grammatical gender even while it shares the same predicate.
topics.reason: The article is heard differently before the moon-letter, and the masculine lunar noun is coordinated with the feminine solar noun under one predicate.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the reckoning noun and beginning the predicate phrase
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the smallest load-bearing element in the ayah. It governs the following reckoning noun, begins the predicate phrase, and makes the relation mediated: the sun and moon are by reckoning, in a reckoning framework, or in a manner of reckoning rather than simply equated with a bare noun. The particle also marks the received construction against an accusative variant without the preposition, so the calculation is not detached from its grammatical frame. Its fused written form and delayed position make the governing law arrive only after the pair has been assembled, then pull the phrase into the nasal close of the final reckoning word.

topics.headline: preposition carries the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole clause turns on a prepositional predicate, so a tiny particle carries the assertion of measured order.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes the prepositional phrase the predicate and identifies the governed reckoning noun as its complement.

topics.headline: means and framework, not every ba function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact double force: the bodies move by reckoning and within a reckoning framework, while unrelated ba functions stay outside the local reading.
topics.reason: The grammar supports instrument, manner, or locative-framework force, but not oath, price, or other inventory meanings.

topics.headline: bound preposition against bare accusative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the received form visibly keeps reckoning attached to a governing frame, unlike an accusative alternative where the noun would stand free.
topics.reason: The preposition is written as a proclitic and governs genitive case; the variant without it is a contrast, not the local form.

topics.headline: delayed hinge into the ending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition arrives after both subjects and pulls the short ayah into its nasal reckoning close.
topics.reason: The particle is postponed until the pair is complete, then fuses with the final noun and contributes to the compact close.

words.gloss_range: reckoning, calculated measure, or operative computation as an indefinite genitive verbal noun under the preposition
words.root_gloss_range: counting, reckoning, accounting, supposing, sufficiency, accountability, and other branches; local form selects precise ordered calculation while allowing accounting pressure as narrowed background
words.prose: {{ar:حُسْبَانٍۢ}} ({{tr:ḥusbānin}}) is the ayah's landing word: the visible bodies resolve into calculation. As an indefinite genitive verbal noun governed by the preposition, it names an open reckoning framework rather than a closed equation or a free accusative specification. The root {{ar:ح س ب}} ({{tr:ḥ-s-b}}) selects counting and precise reckoning here; supposition, sufficiency, projectiles, and punishment are not the local sense, though accounting and audit pressure remain as narrowed background to measured order. Its masdar and fuʿlān shape make the calculation feel operative and ongoing without naming a visible counter. The word also compresses wider Quranic comparisons: 6:96 gives the sun-moon reckoning field through a different accusative lens, 10:5 spells out years and calculation, 3:37 contrasts provision beyond reckoning, and 40:27 keeps the root's account-language in view. Finally, the long final cadence and nasal close make the reckoning term linger, while the boundary from 55:4, 55:6, and 55:7 links human articulation, cosmic calculation, submission, and balance within the surah's mercy frame without turning those later terms into the local gloss.

topics.headline: governed predicate, not free specification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reckoning is the clause predicate through a governed prepositional frame, not a loose accusative label beside the bodies.
topics.reason: The local grammar makes the noun genitive under the preposition and makes the prepositional phrase the khabar; accusative patterns are contrastive only.

topics.headline: indefinite reckoning stays open-ended
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah says reckoning as an open framework, not the calculation as a named closed formula.
topics.reason: Tanwin and indefiniteness are locally present and operate inside the same predicate frame.

topics.headline: counting branch selected over guesses and missiles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root's broad family is narrowed to exact calculation for cosmic order, while rejected local branches clarify what the word is not doing.
topics.reason: V4 includes supposition, sufficiency, projectile, and other branches, but the sun-moon predicate selects counting and ordered reckoning; the other branches are not local senses.

topics.headline: calculation keeps accounting pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the computation is also reckoning in the account sense, but without a named auditor, accused party, or punishment scene.
topics.reason: The broader root family supports accounting pressure, while the local nominal cosmic frame blocks personal audit or punishment as the direct scene.

topics.headline: verbal noun makes computation systemic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form presents calculation as an operating system or process, not as a finite act by a visible counter.
topics.reason: The word is tagged as a gerund/verbal noun; the supplied fuʿlān process claim is useful but narrowed because V4 has no same-form corpus examples for stronger activation.

topics.headline: selected form keeps preposition, pattern, and openness together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the received form joins b-governance, indefinite openness, and the ḥusbān pattern in one final predicate.
topics.reason: Variant forms expose pressure points, but the received local form keeps the prepositionally governed indefinite noun.

topics.headline: reckoning condenses wider Quranic fields
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one word condenses explicit sun-moon calculation, year-counting, provision-beyond-reckoning, and account-language comparisons.
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete references: 6:96 shares the sun-moon reckoning field, 10:5 expands year-counting, 3:37 negates reckoning for provision, and 40:27 applies the root to eschatological accounting.

topics.headline: final word makes reckoning linger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not end on a celestial body but on the longer, resonant measure-word.
topics.reason: The noun is the final lexical word, carries a long vowel and nasal ending, and follows two shorter subject units.

topics.headline: motion is compressed into the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a recoverable motion idea remains behind the scene, but the visible clause makes calculation itself the predicate.
topics.reason: The local attachment evidence licenses the prepositional phrase as predicate; any omitted running verb is recoverable as compression, not the overt syntax.

topics.headline: calculation bridges articulation, submission, and balance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 55:5 sits between human expression in 55:4 and later submission and balance language in 55:6 and 55:7, so calculation is part of a larger ordered-intelligibility sequence within the surah's mercy frame.
topics.reason: The boundary rows compare adjacent ayah movement; they shape discourse payoff without changing the local gloss of the word.

topics.headline: marked ḥusbān choice converges

topics.reason: The root is common across many forms, but the local choice is the mechanism noun in a short cosmic predicate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated pair الشمس والقمر is qualified together by بحسبان.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two unequal lights form one operational system: solar radiance and lunar light or phase become repeatable because counting and proportion coordinate them.

activation_trace.role: The sun and its daylight supply the bright member of the coordinated system.
The moon and its changing light supply the nocturnal and phase-marked member.
Counting, measure, and ordered celestial calculation bind both lights into one repeatable regime.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely names two celestial objects and says that they are regular.
changed_reading.after: It presents the sun and moon as a coupled, measurable time-and-orientation system.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The lunar member and بحسبان can activate both perceptual uncertainty and mental or investigative reckoning.
baseline_models.mechanism: Brilliant appearance does not interpret itself: potentially bewildering light first yields supposition, then becomes a testable model through repeated inquiry and reckoning.

activation_trace.role: Sight bewildered by intense whiteness supplies the perceptual problem that bare luminosity can create.
Mental supposition supplies a provisional model rather than automatic certainty.
Seeking and testing information turns the provisional model into disciplined observation.

changed_reading.before: بحسبان states a transparent objective fact needing no observer.
changed_reading.after: It can also stage disciplined inference, converting dazzling appearances and supposition into a tested reckoning.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same three focus roots can join light, ecological abundance, and enoughness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alternating solar and lunar conditions are not only a clock; their proportion apportions enough light, water, and pasture for a habitable cycle.

activation_trace.role: Sunlight supplies exposure and daytime energy to the provisioning cycle.
Abundant water and pasture turn the lunar root into an ecological yield image.
Sufficiency makes proportion serve enoughness rather than numerical description alone.

changed_reading.before: The pair is only a celestial clock.
changed_reading.after: The pair is also a calibrated provisioning cycle whose measure makes earthly sufficiency possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy, teaching, and articulated disclosure frame celestial reckoning as a readable gift: the pattern is made available to know, distinguish, and communicate.

activation_trace.role: Information-seeking makes the focus reckoning an epistemic practice.
Tender mercy gives the disclosed order a beneficent frame rather than a detached technical one.
Knowledge as disclosure makes an otherwise hidden order available to a knower.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign makes the measured lights a legible sign-system.

structural_cues: 55:1-5 moves from mercy through teaching, creation, and articulation to the measured luminaries.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies that sequence and the disclosure branches; I infer that the sequence pedagogically frames 55:5, while a live alternative is that the ayat simply place distinct gifts side by side.

changed_reading.before: The regularity is an impersonal astronomical property.
changed_reading.after: The regularity is also a mercifully disclosed grammar by which creation becomes readable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calculation and prostration become two bodily registers of compliance: the luminaries keep proportion, while star or stemless growth and tree lower themselves.

activation_trace.role: Ordered calculation supplies the luminaries' nonverbal mode of compliance.
The rising star extends patterned celestial action beyond the named sun and moon.
The stemless plant variant simultaneously brings low terrestrial growth into the same compliant pattern.
The trunked tree supplies the upright terrestrial counterpart to the ambiguous najm.
Lowering and humility interpret regular natural action as enacted submission.

structural_cues: The adjacent ayat coordinate two subjects in 55:5 and another dual subject with a dual verb in 55:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, dual syntax, ordered count, and lowering; I supply the analogy that regularity is a form of compliance, while the alternative is merely two separate descriptions of nature.

changed_reading.before: The sun and moon behave like neutral clockwork.
changed_reading.after: Their measured recurrence can be read as their distinctive enactment of submission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The celestial proportion becomes a norm-bearing prototype: a placed balance sets limits, and human action must neither overrun nor shortchange those limits but realize them as equity.

activation_trace.role: Count and proportion provide the focus model of exact relation.
Placing something in its fixed position makes measure instituted rather than accidental.
The balance of justice transfers exact relation into the ethical domain.
Exceeding a limit identifies the failure mode that measured order blocks.
Fairness and equity specify the human realization of balance.
Shortchanging weight supplies the opposite distortion, loss by deficient measure.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 repeats الميزان and moves from its placement to prohibitions and commands addressed to agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies celestial count followed by instituted balance, excess, equity, and short measure; I infer a cosmos-to-ethics analogy, while the live alternative is that astronomical and commercial measures are parallel but not causally linked.

changed_reading.before: 55:5 reports descriptive precision in the sky.
changed_reading.after: 55:5 also furnishes a visible norm for just proportion, bounded against both excess and deficiency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fertile ground, palms, enclosing fruit sheaths, and seed make celestial measure a developmental clock: enoughness depends on ordered exposure and protection until ripeness.

activation_trace.role: Cold-struck dates losing sweetness before ripening supply the concrete risk of mistimed exposure.
Abundant water and pasture supply the successful ecological yield.
Enoughness makes successful timing answer a need rather than maximize without limit.
Soft fertile earth provides the receiving field for the celestial cycle.
The palm makes lunar cold damage and seasonal reckoning materially consequential.
The plant vessel and fruit covering supply timed protection during development.
Seed that grows and bears grain completes the protected sequence from timing to yield.

structural_cues: 55:10-12 descends from the measured sky to earth, fruit, protective enclosures, grain, and plant matter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured luminaries, premature date damage, fertile earth, palms, coverings, and seed; I infer that solar-lunar timing regulates development, while the alternative is a general abundance list without a calendrical arrow.

changed_reading.after: Celestial calculation is also a ripening discipline whose proportion protects and provisions living processes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurring dual question turns the surah into an iterated account: benefactions are presented, counted as grounds of standing, and tested against denial.

activation_trace.role: Counted merits and grounds of standing turn حساب into an evaluative inventory.
Benefits supply the recurring items entered into the account.
Nurturing, repair, and completion identify the benefactor whose provisions are being reckoned.
Contradicting truth supplies the failed response that the repeated account exposes.

structural_cues: The same dual question recurs from 55:13 through 55:77 after changing scenes of creation, judgment, and provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated question about benefits and denial plus the focus branch of counted merits; I infer a rhetorical ledger, while the alternative is refrain as emphasis without cumulative accounting.

changed_reading.before: The sun and moon are one isolated example of physical calculation.
changed_reading.after: They inaugurate a recurring moral inventory in which visible benefits become evidence that demands acknowledgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two lights' reckoning acquires spatial endpoints: emergence and disappearance across paired easts and wests turn count into horizon geometry.

activation_trace.role: The solar disk and daylight provide the most visibly horizon-bound member.
The moon and moonlight provide a second moving horizon marker.
Ordered calculation relates repeated appearances to measurable positions.
Light rising from the east supplies the entry boundary of the visible course.
Sunset and west supply the corresponding withdrawal boundary.

structural_cues: 55:17 places dual easts and dual wests around a discourse already opened by paired luminaries.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus pair and paired rise-set boundaries; I infer that these make reckoning spatially observable, while retaining the alternative that the dual horizons need not map one-to-one onto the two bodies.

changed_reading.before: The calculation is an abstract number attached to two bodies.
changed_reading.after: The calculation is visibly enacted as repeated emergence, traversal, and withdrawal between horizon limits.

context_deltas.mechanism: A pair can meet and interact without collapsing into sameness: disturbance is admitted, encounter occurs, and an intervening relation prevents one side from overrunning the other.

activation_trace.role: Proportion supplies the rule by which two distinct members remain coordinated.
Mixing and perturbation make the paired relation dynamically interactive rather than merely adjacent.
Two things arriving face to face supply actual encounter between the members.
The middle interval supplies a relation that both joins and distinguishes the sides.
Transgressive overrun names the coupling failure that the boundary prevents.

structural_cues: 55:19-20 gives two seas a meeting, an explicit barrier between them, and a negated dual act of overrun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a measured focus pair and a later bounded pair; I transfer the relational mechanism to sun and moon, while the live alternative is that the sea mechanism remains domain-specific.

changed_reading.before: The sun and moon are two independent tracks sharing only a numerical rule.
changed_reading.after: They can be read as a coupled pair whose measure permits relation while preserving non-overrun and distinction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counted recurrence belongs to the finite created totality, yet each temporal unit remains actively administered: perishing cycles contrast with what remains, while requests and affairs are handled day by day.

activation_trace.role: Lunar light and fullness supply a conspicuous recurring phase-cycle.
Accountable management turns recurrence into an administered schedule.
Encompassing totality places the luminaries inside the scope of creaturely finitude.
Cessation after persistence prevents recurrence from implying self-subsisting permanence.
Enduring remainder supplies the contrast against which the measured cycles are finite.
Request and seeking make administration responsive rather than mechanically closed.
A bounded duration supplies the recurring unit within which affairs unfold.
Setting work right gives each temporal unit an active governing operation.

structural_cues: 55:26-29 juxtaposes universal perishing, enduring presence, universal asking, and a fresh affair in every day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured recurrence, finitude, endurance, requests, days, and repaired affairs; I infer dependence and continuous governance, while the alternative is an impersonal clock followed by an unrelated statement of providence.

changed_reading.before: The celestial clock looks autonomous and indefinitely self-running.
changed_reading.after: Its finite recurrence is continuously sustained and administered within a larger contrast of perishing and endurance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calculation can function as jurisdiction: paths across celestial regions are not merely distances but authorized or blocked passages through bounded sides.

activation_trace.role: Guarding and withholding supply a gate-like counterimage within the solar root.
Ordered measure defines admissible paths and limits rather than distance alone.
Passing cleanly to the other side supplies the challenged boundary-crossing operation.
Sides and regions turn the heavens into a bounded domain with edges.
Compelling warrant or proof supplies the authorization required for passage.

structural_cues: 55:33 repeats the penetration challenge and allows it only with سلطان.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured celestial bodies, regional sides, blocked penetration, and required authority; I infer that حساب also evokes jurisdictional constraint, while the alternative confines the challenge to its later eschatological scene.

changed_reading.before: The luminaries simply travel along calculable trajectories.
changed_reading.after: Their trajectories can model authorized movement inside a bounded celestial jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reckoning no longer needs verbal interrogation when condition is visibly marked: recognition follows the sign, and accountable seizure follows recognition.

activation_trace.role: Holding to account supplies the administrative logic of the later scene.
Questioning and request supply the procedure explicitly negated in the scene.
Recognition through an effect or sign replaces the need for interrogation.
A visible mark that indicates condition makes the account bodily legible.
Seizure on account of fault turns recognized condition into an executed judgment.

structural_cues: 55:39 negates questioning; 55:41 supplies recognition by marks and immediate taking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies no questioning, visible marks, recognition, and fault-based seizure; I infer a pre-resolved embodied account, while the alternative is immediate divine knowledge without any link back to celestial reckoning.

changed_reading.before: حساب in 55:5 remains value-neutral physical arithmetic.
changed_reading.after: Its accountable branch anticipates an audit whose evidence is already legible and whose result is enacted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measure is generative rather than austere: concealed gardens, flowing sources, paired fruits, and near harvest show proportion repeatedly producing accessible plenitude.

activation_trace.role: Abundant water and pasture give the lunar root a plenitude-bearing ecological branch.
Sufficiency lets exact proportion yield ample provision rather than scarcity.
A garden concealed by dense growth supplies the provisioned habitat.
A flowing water source makes abundance continuously available.
One counterpart joined to another repeats the focus pair inside provision.
Taking ripe produce from its growth turns ordered abundance into usable yield.
Nearness removes access friction, making the measured provision readily obtainable.

structural_cues: 55:46-54 repeats dual gardens, dual springs, paired fruit kinds, and near harvest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus branches of abundance and enoughness followed by paired, flowing, harvestable provision; I infer that measure generates plenitude, while the alternative treats the garden sequence solely as reward imagery.

changed_reading.before: Exact calculation suggests restriction to a bare minimum.
changed_reading.after: Exact calculation can instead be the architecture by which abundant provision is paired, renewed, and made accessible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The account becomes qualitative correspondence: a good act and its return mirror one another, so measure preserves kind and relation rather than merely adding quantities.

activation_trace.role: Reckoning and proportion supply exact relational correspondence.
Counted merits make the correspondence evaluative rather than only physical.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the return relation.
A good act repeated as good return makes the relation visibly symmetrical.

structural_cues: 55:60 repeats الإحسان on both sides of an exclusive reward question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies count, merit, recompense, and repeated good; I infer a measure of fitting correspondence, while the alternative is a moral axiom independent of the astronomical pair.

changed_reading.before: The focus measure coordinates only physical positions and periods.
changed_reading.after: It can also prefigure a moral proportion in which response fittingly mirrors action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The gambling branch is remote from the ordinary noun moon, so this is not a lexical replacement for القمر. It remains anchored because the focus places that root directly beside exact reckoning and later places reckoning beside just balance; render it only as an associative counter-image in which chance, contest, or trickery is subordinated to measure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: القمر immediately followed by بحسبان permits the lunar root's gambling image to collide with exact account.

activation_trace.role: Gambling, contest, and deceptive victory supply the chance-governed counter-system.
Exact count and proportion defeat the counter-system's uncertainty and manipulation.
Fair dealing sharpens the contrast between accountable proportion and deceptive winning.

changed_reading.before: The lunar root's contest branch is inert noise beside the literal moon.
changed_reading.after: As a contained counter-image, the verse converts a field of apparent chance or contest into non-manipulable cosmic account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The cushion branch is form-distant from حسبان and cannot define the focus word directly. It remains worth carrying because later reclining and spread supports activate the same functional image; render it as a qualified material analogy in which calculation bears or stabilizes the pair, not as a dictionary gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The prepositional بحسبان can imaginatively cast the measured order as what the paired luminaries rest upon.

activation_trace.role: A small cushion and the act of propping supply a support image internal to the focus root.
Reclining by reliance on a support activates the bearing function rather than mere restraint.
Spreading and preparing a surface supplies the stable substrate on which ordered rest occurs.

changed_reading.before: Calculation constrains the sun and moon from outside.
changed_reading.after: Calculation can be imagined, cautiously, as the supporting substrate that holds their coordinated relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: A damaged waterskin is a highly branch-distant material analogy, and the packet does not say that the sky is literally a skin or vessel. The image remains anchored in the focus moon-root and becomes mechanistic when the later sky splits and takes an oily appearance; downstream prose should mark this only as an exploratory model of maintained layered integrity and catastrophic failure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The lunar root's damaged layered vessel branch sits inside a verse of normal celestial regulation.

activation_trace.role: A waterskin spoiled when fluid enters between layers supplies the vulnerable-envelope image.
Ordered calculation supplies the envelope's normal maintained regime.
Splitting open supplies the catastrophic loss of integrity.
Rose-red color supplies the altered visible state after rupture.
Oil or coating supplies the liquefied surface analogy of the failed medium.
A textile lining confirms that inner and outer layers are a live material pattern in the context.

changed_reading.before: Celestial calculation appears as an immutable and purely abstract law.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can be pictured as maintained material integrity whose catastrophic reversal reveals a once-regulated layered medium.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The restive-animal branch anthropomorphizes the sun and must not be presented as the lexical sense of الشمس. It remains anchored because the focus subjects that root to حساب and nearby context opposes submission to limit-breaking; render it as a counterfactual image of what measured order contains.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الشمس under بحسبان allows the solar root's restive refusal branch to function as the disorder held in check.

activation_trace.role: Restive refusal and failure to settle supply the latent deviation from a stable course.
Accountable supervision supplies the containing discipline.
Lowering and submission supply the realized opposite of restive refusal.
Overrunning a limit names the disorder that supervision prevents.

changed_reading.before: Regularity is passive and contains no live alternative.
changed_reading.after: As a contained counter-image, حساب actively disciplines a latent restiveness into settled, submissive recurrence.

strongest_changes: Celestial calculation became a readable act of merciful disclosure rather than impersonal clockwork.
The placed balance converted descriptive proportion into a norm against excess, deficiency, and injustice.
Paired seas, horizons, gardens, springs, and fruits exposed حساب as bounded coupling and generative abundance.
The recurring benefit question and later marked judgment activated an evaluative, embodied account.
Finitude and day-by-day affairs revised the clock from autonomous recurrence to continuously governed duration.
summary.what_was_special: The compact focus construction sustained several coexisting mechanisms: physical count, observational inference, ecological timing, sufficient provision, accountable administration, and relational balance. Branch-distant images did additional work as contained counter-models, especially gamble versus account, restraint versus support, and normal regulation versus layered rupture.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntactic بحسبان most directly supports count and proportion; sufficiency, supervision, cushion, and supposition remain branch activations rather than settled glosses.
The horizon, sea-boundary, moral-balance, and garden mechanisms may be deliberate transfers from 55:5 or may remain juxtaposed analogies.
The anti-gamble, restive-sun, and layered-vessel readings are valuable for discovery but require explicit downstream qualification because of form or domain distance.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Celestial motion as accounting.** `ح س ب/B001` explicitly includes ordered calculation of sun and moon. The subsequent balance and warning against shorting measure (55:7–9) provide the structural cue; I infer a continuity from cosmic regularity to human accountability. The ayah reads as a visible model for exact social measure.
2. **Reckoning as sufficiency.** `ح س ب/B003` (enoughness) is activated by the provision sequence in 55:10–12. I infer that calculated courses enable sufficient rhythms for earthly life. This remains separate from numerical counting: the ayah can also read as a system whose measured regularity is enough to sustain what follows.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:29 (“every day ... an affair”) prevents the calculated order from becoming mechanical stasis. Regularity and ongoing action coexist; the reckoning is stable without implying divine inactivity.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **`ح س ب` `B001` — “counting and ordered courses.”** Structural cue: the verbless pairing of sun and moon is governed by the single prepositional phrase `بِحُسْبَانٍ`, then 55:7–9 repeats `ٱلْمِيزَانَ` and `ٱلْوَزْنَ`. Assigned role: reckoning supplies the cosmic exemplar for the later prohibition and imperatives about measure. Packet evidence is the paired luminaries and repeated weighing vocabulary. Inference: observed regularity authorizes the demand that agents maintain proportion. Reading change: the ayah becomes the descriptive premise of an ethical calibration argument.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:9 confirmed the normative turn: its paired imperatives made celestial reckoning in 55:5 function as a model that human weighing must actively reproduce.

Ay'ın ışığı, bu ışıkla aydınlanan gece ve Ay'ın bir topluluk üzerine doğması aynı dala bağlı kullanımlardır.
Ay adının başlangıç sınırı hilalden sonraki birkaç geceyle, belirgin evresi ise dolunayla ilişkilendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gökteki Ay, ay ışığı ve ayla aydınlanan gece üzerinde birleşir; adın ayın hangi evresinden itibaren öne çıktığı konusunda hilal sonrası ile dolunay arasında farklı sınırlar verir.

concept_gloss.text: Ay, ay ışığı ve ayla aydınlanan gece
concept_gloss.applicability: Gök cismi ile ondan gelen ışığın oluşturduğu temel anlam alanını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Gök cismini, onun ışığını ve ışığın geceyi aydınlatmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ay'ın görünür hale gelerek bir topluluğun üzerine doğmasını bildiren kullanımda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ay'ın doğup insanlarca görünür hale gelmesi olayını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hayvan ve bulut betimlemelerinde beyaz, çok açık ya da yeşile çalan bir rengi açıkça tanımlar. Bu nedenle dal genel beyazlık değil, ay ışığına benzetilen ve bağlama göre yeşilimsi olabilen özel bir renk niteliğidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, Ay'ın kendisini ya da ışığını değil, özellikle hayvanlar ve bulutlar için kullanılan beyazımsı veya yeşile çalan rengi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın renk dalıyla sınırlıdır; ay ışığına ilişkin gece ve aydınlanma kullanımları bu dala taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Özellikle hayvan ve bulut betimlemelerinde görülen, beyazdan çok açık beyaza uzanan ve kimi anlatımlarda yeşile çalan ay ışığı benzeri bir renktir.

facets.statement: Renk çekirdeği beyaz veya çok açık beyazdır; bazı aktarımlarda yeşile çalan bir ton taşır.
Bu renk eşek, dişi eşek, seçkin deve ve bulut gibi varlıkların niteliği olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar beyazlık üzerinde birleşir; bazı anlatımlar rengi çok açık beyaz olarak verirken bazıları yeşile çalan tonu özellikle belirtir ve kullanım alanını hayvanlarla bulutlara yayar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ay ışığında birine gitmeyi, avcının veya aslanın gece ava çıkmasını, kuş ya da ceylanların görüşünü şaşırtarak onları yakalamayı ve birinin gafletinden yararlanmayı aynı dalda toplar. Verilen çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak anlam genel olarak yönelmek veya avlanmak değildir; ay aydınlığı, gece görüşü ya da hazırlıksız yakalama koşulu korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca ay ışığında yaklaşma ve gece avında görüşü şaşırtıp gafil yakalama kullanımlarını kapsar; genel avlanma veya genel aldatma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, birbirine bağlı fakat ayrı yapılardaki ay ışığında yaklaşma, gece ava çıkma ve avın görüşünü şaşırtma kullanımlarını karıştırmadan gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Birine ay ışığında yaklaşmayı veya gece ava çıkmayı anlatır; av bağlamında ışık ya da karanlık yüzünden görüşü şaşan hayvanı hazırlıksız yakalayıp avlama sonucuna uzanır. Bir kişinin gafletinden yararlanıp onu aldatma kullanımı da bu hazırlıksız yakalama çizgisine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye ay ışığında gitmek veya yaklaşmak dalın temel gece koşullu kullanımıdır.
Aslanın ya da avcının gece ava çıkması ve avın görüşünü şaşırtarak onu yakalaması özel avcılık gerçekleşmesidir.
Birinin gafletini kollayıp onu hazırlıksız yakalamak veya aldatmak, avcılık görüntüsünden gelişen uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ay ışığında yaklaşma ile gece avını ortak alanda verir; toplu ifade avın görüşünü şaşırtma, gafleti kollama ve aldatma ayrıntılarını da içerir, ancak bunlar genel aldatma anlamına dönüştürülmemelidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çekirdeği para veya mal ortaya konan talih oyununda karşılaşma ve rakibi yenmedir; rakip arama ve hileyle aldatma bununla bağlantılı uzantılardır. Çerçevedeki aldatma unsuru bütün oyun eylemlerinin zorunlu özelliği gibi sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, ortaya değer koyulan talih oyunu, bu oyunda rakip arama ve yenme ile hileli aldatma uzantısını kapsar; her tür risk alma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, oyun adını ve karşılıklı oynama çekirdeğini rakip arama, yenme ve aldatma bildiren yapılardan ayırarak korur.

concept_map.definition: Para ya da mal gibi bir değer ortaya koyulan talih oyununda karşılıklı oynamayı ve rakibi yenmeyi anlatır. Oynayacak rakip arama ve birini hileyle aldatarak üstün gelme anlamları bu çekirdeğe bağlı uzantılardır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bir değer ortaya koyulan talih oyununda tarafların karşılıklı oynamasıdır.
Bir rakip aramak, onunla karşılaşmak ve oyunda onu yenmek eylem zincirinin özel aşamalarıdır.
Birini hileyle aldatıp ondan üstün çıkmak, oyun çekirdeğinden gelişen fakat her oyunda zorunlu olmayan uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşılıklı talih oyunu ve rakibi yenme çekirdeğinde birleşir; toplu ifade rakip arama, övünme yarışı ve hileyle aldatma ayrıntılarını da farklı ağırlıklarla kapsar.

word_morpheme_spans.note: Accepted bridge links preserve independent analysis identities. Several analysis entries may share canonical morphemes. Read their distinct semantic claims; shared morphology alone is not duplication. Legacy aligned_qac_word_ref values are source observations, not QAC joins. Excluded source entries remain available with their explicit qualification.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: Legacy analysis and QAC numbers are separate source namespaces. Use accepted word_morpheme_spans for actual many-to-many joins. The legacy numbering observation is preserved, not used for alignment.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
